hardExceptions.en: UCAS application. For 2027 entry, equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 at 6pm GMT; 15 October 2026 at 6pm GMT for Medicine and Dentistry (Manchester how-to-apply page). UCAT + interview mandatory for Medicine (SJT Band 3-4 not considered) and Dentistry; Nursing shortlists applicants for interview. tuition_eu is the published 2027/28 Home fee GBP 10,050 stated across Manchester 2027 course pages; international 2027/28 fees on published course pages range GBP 29,200 (classroom-based) to GBP 41,900 (Materials Science and Engineering); Medicine/Dentistry pages publish 2026/27 figures (Home GBP 9,535; international GBP 38,300-39,900 pre-clinical).
hardExceptions.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS. Na nástup v roku 2027 je termín equal consideration 13. januára 2027 o 18:00 GMT (6pm); 15. októbra 2026 o 18:00 GMT (6pm) pre Medicine a Dentistry (stránka Manchester how-to-apply). UCAT + pohovor sú povinné pre Medicine (SJT Band 3-4 sa neakceptuje) a Dentistry; pri Nursing sa robí užší výber uchádzačov na pohovor. tuition_eu je zverejnený poplatok Home na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 uvedený na stránkach odborov Manchester pre 2027; medzinárodné poplatky na 2027/28 na zverejnených stránkach odborov sú od GBP 29,200 (odbory v učebniach) do GBP 41,900 (Materials Science and Engineering); stránky Medicine/Dentistry uvádzajú sumy na 2026/27 (Home GBP 9,535; medzinárodný GBP 38,300-39,900 v predklinickej časti).

hardExceptions.en: UCAS application (UCAS name STA, number code S36); overseas students may instead use the Common Application or a Direct Application. Equal consideration deadline for all MA and BSc undergraduate applications: 6pm (GMT) Wednesday 13 January 2027; Medicine: 6pm (GMT) Thursday 15 October 2026. Personal statement and academic reference required; most applicants are not interviewed (exceptions: Medicine, supported pathway programmes, part-time study). Applicants from other countries should use the Standard entry requirements; Standard, Minimum and Gateway levels are explained on the academic entry explained page.
hardExceptions.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS (názov v UCAS STA, kód S36); zahraniční študenti môžu namiesto toho použiť Common Application alebo Direct Application. Termín equal consideration pre všetky bakalárske prihlášky MA a BSc: 18:00 GMT (6pm) v stredu 13. januára 2027; Medicine: 18:00 GMT (6pm) vo štvrtok 15. októbra 2026. Vyžaduje sa motivačný text (personal statement) a akademické odporúčanie; väčšina uchádzačov nemá pohovor (výnimky: Medicine, programy supported pathway, štúdium popri práci (part-time)). Uchádzači z iných krajín sa majú riadiť požiadavkami Standard entry requirements; úrovne Standard, Minimum a Gateway vysvetľuje stránka academic entry explained.

hardExceptions.en: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses. UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline 13 January 2027 (Leeds Application timetable page); applications received after the deadline are considered if places remain. Medicine and Surgery MBChB applicants must apply by 15 October 2026 and take the UCAT; shortlisted applicants are interviewed (selection also uses 8 GCSEs). Fine Art BA requires a portfolio of work; applicants already on a Level-3 Fine Art pathway or Access to Leeds are exempt. Law LLB does not require LNAT. English Literature, History and Philosophy BA note that an interview and a piece of written work 'may be required'. No STEP, MAT, TMUA or other admissions tests are listed for the remaining undergraduate courses researched - selection is on UCAS application plus GCSE prerequisites. Home fee (tuition_eu) is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 ('Tuition fees for UK undergraduate students starting in 2027/28 are GBP 10,050'; UK regulated cap subject to parliamentary approval). Overseas 2027/28 fee bands printed on course pages (per year, unchanged for duration of the course): GBP 27,300 (Politics BA, International Relations BA, Global Development BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Communication and Media BA, Fine Art BA); GBP 27,600 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Economics, Economics and Finance, Business Management, International Business); GBP 30,400 (Mathematics, Actuarial Mathematics, Geography BA/BSc); GBP 31,300 (Accounting and Finance); GBP 33,700 (Computer Science, Physics MPhys,BSc, Chemistry MChem,BSc, all engineering MEng,BEng courses, Food Science, Nutrition); GBP 33,800 (Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Psychology); GBP 50,500 (Medicine and Surgery MBChB). Reduced fees apply for study-abroad/work-placement years (UK GBP 1,505; international GBP 4,575).
hardExceptions.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS pre všetky denné bakalárske odbory. Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je 13. januára 2027 (stránka Leeds Application timetable); prihlášky prijaté po termíne sa posudzujú, ak zostanú voľné miesta. Uchádzači o Medicine and Surgery MBChB sa musia prihlásiť do 15. októbra 2026 a urobiť UCAT; uchádzači v užšom výbere majú pohovor (pri výbere sa zohľadňuje aj 8 GCSE). Fine Art BA vyžaduje portfólio prác; uchádzači, ktorí už sú na Level-3 Fine Art pathway alebo v Access to Leeds, sú od neho oslobodení. Law LLB nevyžaduje LNAT. Pri English Literature, History a Philosophy BA sa uvádza, že pohovor a písomná práca 'may be required'. Pri ostatných preverených bakalárskych odboroch nie sú uvedené STEP, MAT, TMUA ani iné prijímacie testy - výber prebieha na základe prihlášky UCAS a požiadaviek na GCSE. Poplatok Home (tuition_eu) je zverejnená sadzba na 2027/28 GBP 10,050 ('Tuition fees for UK undergraduate students starting in 2027/28 are GBP 10,050'; regulovaný strop v UK, podlieha schváleniu parlamentom). Pásma poplatkov Overseas na 2027/28 uvedené na stránkach odborov (ročne, nemenné počas celého štúdia): GBP 27,300 (Politics BA, International Relations BA, Global Development BA, Sociology BA, English Literature BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Communication and Media BA, Fine Art BA); GBP 27,600 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Economics, Economics and Finance, Business Management, International Business); GBP 30,400 (Mathematics, Actuarial Mathematics, Geography BA/BSc); GBP 31,300 (Accounting and Finance); GBP 33,700 (Computer Science, Physics MPhys,BSc, Chemistry MChem,BSc, všetky inžinierske odbory MEng,BEng, Food Science, Nutrition); GBP 33,800 (Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience, Psychology); GBP 50,500 (Medicine and Surgery MBChB). Za rok štúdia v zahraničí/praxe platia znížené poplatky (UK GBP 1,505; medzinárodný GBP 4,575).
hardExceptions.reason: Expands GCSEs to GCSE, preserving all requirements.

hardExceptions.en: UCAS application for all full-time undergraduate courses (University of Birmingham UCAS campus code B32). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (Birmingham How to apply for undergraduate study page). UCAS 2027-entry deadline for Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200): Thursday 15 October 2026. Admissions tests: UCAT in year of application plus interview required for Medicine MBChB and Dentistry BDS; LNAT is NOT required for Law LLB (course page: "We do not require or consider the LNAT admissions test for entry onto our programmes"). No TMUA, MAT, STEP or other admissions test listed for other undergraduate courses; Engineering applicants without A-level Mathematics may be asked to sit a Birmingham Mathematics Aptitude test. Music BMus may require an audition/interview for applicants without the standard Music qualification; ABRSM Grade 8 Performance or Grade 6 Theory accepted as alternative. Additional reductions: contextual offers (typically one grade lower), Pathways to Birmingham (typically two grades lower), EPQ alternative offer (one grade lower plus grade B in EPQ; excludes Medicine A100 and Dentistry A200), Core Maths alternative offer for selected programmes (excludes programmes with A-level Mathematics requirement), Music performance Grade 8 alternative offer, county-level sport alternative offer. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year tuition printed per course: GBP 24,840 (Politics BA, International Relations BA); GBP 25,320 (Modern Languages BA); GBP 26,220 (Law LLB, Sociology BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Ancient History and Archaeology BA); GBP 27,300 (English Literature BA); GBP 28,680 (Economics, Money Banking and Finance, Business Management, Marketing); GBP 30,180 (Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Finance, Pharmacy MPharm, Nursing Adult BNurs); GBP 31,680 (Materials Science and Engineering MEng); GBP 33,300 (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, all engineering MEng courses except Materials); Medicine MBChB international GBP 33,750 per year for pre-clinical years 1-2 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 3-5; Dentistry BDS international GBP 30,180 for pre-clinical year 1 and GBP 53,880 per year for clinical years 2-5. International fees for Biological Sciences BSc, Human Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Sport Exercise and Health Sciences BSc, Geography BSc and Environmental Science BSc are listed as "To be confirmed" on the course pages at the time of verification.
hardExceptions.sk: Prihláška cez UCAS pre všetky denné bakalárske odbory (UCAS kód kampusu University of Birmingham B32). Termín equal consideration UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 je v stredu 13. januára 2027 (stránka Birmingham How to apply for undergraduate study). Termín UCAS na nástup v roku 2027 pre Medicine (A100) a Dentistry (A200): štvrtok 15. októbra 2026. Prijímacie testy: UCAT v roku podania prihlášky plus pohovor sú povinné pre Medicine MBChB a Dentistry BDS; LNAT sa pre Law LLB NEVYŽADUJE (stránka odboru: "We do not require or consider the LNAT admissions test for entry onto our programmes"). Pri ostatných bakalárskych odboroch nie je uvedený TMUA, MAT, STEP ani iný prijímací test; uchádzačov o Engineering bez A-level Mathematics môžu požiadať, aby urobili Birmingham Mathematics Aptitude test. Music BMus môže od uchádzačov bez štandardnej hudobnej kvalifikácie vyžadovať prehrávku/pohovor; ako alternatíva sa uznáva ABRSM Grade 8 Performance alebo Grade 6 Theory. Ďalšie zníženia: kontextové ponuky (zvyčajne o jednu známku nižšie), Pathways to Birmingham (zvyčajne o dve známky nižšie), alternatívna ponuka s EPQ (o jednu známku nižšie plus známka B z EPQ; neplatí pre Medicine A100 a Dentistry A200), alternatívna ponuka s Core Maths pre vybrané programy (neplatí pre programy s požiadavkou A-level Mathematics), alternatívna ponuka za hudobný výkon Grade 8, alternatívna ponuka za šport na úrovni grófstva (county). Školné Home na 2027/28: GBP 10,050 ročne. Medzinárodné ročné školné na 2027/28 uvedené pri odboroch: GBP 24,840 (Politics BA, International Relations BA); GBP 25,320 (Modern Languages BA); GBP 26,220 (Law LLB, Sociology BA, History BA, Philosophy BA, Theology and Religion BA, Liberal Arts BA, Music BMus, Ancient History and Archaeology BA); GBP 27,300 (English Literature BA); GBP 28,680 (Economics, Money Banking and Finance, Business Management, Marketing); GBP 30,180 (Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Accounting and Finance, Pharmacy MPharm, Nursing Adult BNurs); GBP 31,680 (Materials Science and Engineering MEng); GBP 33,300 (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science, všetky inžinierske odbory MEng okrem Materials); Medicine MBChB medzinárodné GBP 33,750 ročne v predklinických ročníkoch 1-2 a GBP 53,880 ročne v klinických ročníkoch 3-5; Dentistry BDS medzinárodné GBP 30,180 v predklinickom 1. ročníku a GBP 53,880 ročne v klinických ročníkoch 2-5. Medzinárodné poplatky pre Biological Sciences BSc, Human Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Sport Exercise and Health Sciences BSc, Geography BSc a Environmental Science BSc sú v čase overenia na stránkach odborov uvedené ako "To be confirmed".
